name: Raise Dead
summary: Restore a willing, recently deceased creature to life for a 5,000 gp diamond.
description:
The soul must be willing and able to return, and the target must have died no more than one day per caster level ago. The revived creature returns with 1 hit point per Hit Die and takes two permanent negative levels. A 1st-level subject takes 2 Constitution drain instead and cannot return if that leaves it at Constitution 0 or lower.

Ability scores reduced to 0 rise to 1. Mundane poisons and diseases are removed, while curses and magical diseases remain. Missing body parts are not restored. Each prepared spell or unused spontaneous slot has a 50% chance of being lost. This spell cannot bring back a creature that died of old age or from a death effect, a creature that was turned undead, or a construct, elemental, outsider, or undead creature.
